_meta.title: Draw-Call Baseline (Terrane Edition - v1.0)
_meta.author: Dennis 'dendogg' Smaltz
_meta.description: renderer.info.render.calls measured by tools/ui-check.mjs in four fixed states of the page. Features compare their own states against these numbers to show they add no draw call. Written by the tool; re-record only when a draw call is added on purpose.
changelog: 1.0.0 (11/11/2026) [dendogg + Anthropic - Claude Opus 5.5] — Initial recording with tools/ui-check.mjs --record-baseline: overview 7, selected 9, search 8, dupTies 9 draw calls.
key_features: One entry per state: what the state is, the draw calls, and the list of objects drawn
The parameters it was measured with: data, fixture size and seed, viewport
Compared on every WebGL pass whose parameters match

overview.what: the home view after the survey, nothing selected, Kind lens

selected.what: the first item of the focus selected with ArrowDown on the canvas (selection frames)

search.what: Find "copy-" with matches, nothing selected (search pins)

dupTies.what: copy-a.dat revealed from Findings, Find cleared, Duplicates lens (garnet ties)
